findings.friction_name: icon-only menu toggle has no discoverable label
findings.narrative: The icon-only <button><svg/></button> menu toggle carries no data-testid, no accessible name, no stable id, no innerText — none of F103's first four fallback tiers resolve. Both personas independently compute the identical F183 tier-5 structural path: the nearest ancestor carrying a stable id (header#app-toolbar), walked down to the button's own ordinal position among same-tag siblings (nth-of-type(3)). Because both records share the identical (heuristic_tag, step, target_element_identifier) tuple, they correctly merge into one finding at convergence_tier=2 (F183, negative control).
